overloads.semanticRole: The WP SET TEXT command inserts the text passed in the newText parameter as plain text in the targetObj at the position designated by the textPosition parameter.

constraints: WP SET TEXT inserts plain text only, exactly as written, with no style tags applied.
rangeUpdate is only honored when targetObj is a range; it is ignored if targetObj is an element or document.
If rangeUpdate is omitted, the inserted text is included in the resulting range by default (equivalent to wk include in range).
